result.question: Compare R&D spending as a share of revenue across Tesla, Apple, and Nvidia in their most recent fiscal years.
result.answer:
Based on the most recent fiscal year SEC filings for each company, here is how R&D spending as a share of revenue compares across Tesla, Apple, and Nvidia:

**Tesla (FY 2025, ended December 31, 2025):** R&D expense was $6.411 billion on total revenue of $94.827 billion [xbrl:0001628280-26-003952:us-gaap:ResearchAndDevelopmentExpense:2025-12-31] [xbrl:0001628280-26-003952:us-gaap:Revenues:2025-12-31]. This implies an R&D-to-revenue ratio of approximately 6.8%, computed as 6,411 / 94,827.

**Apple (FY 2025, ended September 27, 2025):** R&D expense was $34.550 billion on net sales of $416.161 billion [xbrl:0000320193-25-000079:us-gaap:ResearchAndDevelopmentExpense:2025-09-27] [xbrl:0000320193-25-000079:us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax:2025-09-27]. This implies an R&D-to-revenue ratio of approximately 8.3%, computed as 34,550 / 416,161.

**Nvidia (FY 2026, ended January 25, 2026):** R&D expense was $18.497 billion on revenue of $215.938 billion [xbrl:0001045810-26-000021:us-gaap:ResearchAndDevelopmentExpense:2026-01-25] [xbrl:0001045810-26-000021:us-gaap:Revenues:2026-01-25]. This implies an R&D-to-revenue ratio of approximately 8.6%, computed as 18,497 / 215,938. Nvidia's 10-K also reports R&D as 8.6% of revenue for the year ended January 25, 2026 [0001045810-26-000021:item-7-p007].

In summary, based on these computed ratios, Tesla's R&D intensity (~6.8%) is lower than both Apple's (~8.3%) and Nvidia's (~8.6%). Apple spends the largest absolute amount on R&D at $34.550 billion [xbrl:0000320193-25-000079:us-gaap:ResearchAndDevelopmentExpense:2025-09-27], but its much larger revenue base of $416.161 billion [xbrl:0000320193-25-000079:us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax:2025-09-27] results in a lower R&D intensity than Nvidia's. Nvidia's 10-K confirms its R&D as a percentage of revenue was 8.6% in FY 2026, down from 9.9% in FY 2025 [0001045810-26-000021:item-7-p007].
